issues.summary: 【Test Environment】【Folax】【V5.4.2】【X6870】【India】【English】【Function】【RT】【Chatbot】【Critical】【Must】 Query input and response remain in Hindi after switching App Language from Hindi to English
issues.description:
*Description:*
 Folax fails to refresh/reset the language context after switching the App Language from Hindi back to English.

Once the user sets the App Language to Hindi and performs a query, Folax continues recognizing, displaying, and responding in Hindi even after the App Language is changed to English. Subsequent English voice commands are internally processed using the previous Hindi language state.

As a result:
 * Recognized query text is displayed in Hindi
 * Assistant responses/output are shown in Hindi
 * English language setting is not applied correctly to new queries

This issue is reproducible only after performing a Hindi → English language switch sequence.

*Frequency:*
 Reproducible: 5/5

*Preconditions:*
 * Folax app is installed and launched
 * Device is connected to the internet
 * Voice assistant permission is granted
 * App Language can be switched between Hindi and English
 * Initial App Language is set to Hindi before reproduction steps begin

*Steps to Reproduce:*
 # Open Folax
 # Set App Language to Hindi
 # Ask a query such as: “Open MindHub” (माइंडहब खोलो)
 # Change App Language to English
 # Ask English queries such as:
 ** “Take a photo”
 ** “Take a selfie”
 ** “Open MindHub”
 # Observe the query recognition language and assistant response language

*Actual Result:*
 Folax continues displaying recognized queries and assistant responses in Hindi even after the App Language is switched to English.

!image-2026-05-11-11-13-30-879.png|width=694,height=814!
 *Expected Result:*
 After changing the App Language to English, Folax should immediately process, display, and respond to all subsequent queries in English.
  
  *Video link*: [https://transsioner.feishu.cn/file/TFwmbYXIyoTMPkx2VBgcQ9SfnVP?from=from_copylink] 
  
 *Log link*: [https://transsioner.feishu.cn/file/A6fxbDSymoluqvx9ee6c30JFnMh?from=from_copylink]
